import BusyBeaver.ZFC
open SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC
#print axioms Enum254.step_inv
#print axioms Enum254.sound
#print axioms Enum254.reach
#print axioms Enum254.build
#print axioms Enum254.complete
#print axioms Enum254.enum_halts_iff
#print axioms Enum254.halts_of_no_model
#print axioms Code254.empty_domain_counterexample
#print axioms QuotientSeparation.separation_instance
#print axioms QuotientSeparation.quotient_separation
#print axioms QuotientSeparation.quotient_sep_form
example : Enum254.Halts ↔ Numeric254.NumThm 1 :=
  Enum254.enum_halts_iff.trans (NumericCode254.numThm_iff_c254 1).symm
example (hnone : ∀ (D : Type) (mem : D → D → Prop), (∀ x, ¬ mem x x) →
    (∀ f, Code254.EncBundle f → ∀ e : Nat → D, Tarski.Sat mem e f) →
    (Nat → D) → False) : Enum254.Halts := Enum254.halts_of_no_model hnone
example {V : Type} (mem : V → V → Prop) (hirr : ∀ x, ¬ mem x x)
    (v : V) (h : Code254Models.ModelsDecoded mem) :
    ∀ phi env, SetTheory.Sat
      (QuotientModel.quotientMember mem v
        (Code254Models.modelsCPGIC_of_decoded mem hirr h (fun _ => v))) env
      (SetTheory.Sep_form phi) :=
  QuotientSeparation.quotient_sep_form mem v
    (Code254Models.modelsCPGIC_of_decoded mem hirr h (fun _ => v))
